title: Compost bins
description: Three open-fronted wooden slatted compost bays in a row along x (8 x 2.4 m), open to +Z: square posts with caps, gapped slats along the back and on the dividers, a heap in each bay (dark finished compost, brown half-rotted, fresh green clippings) and a little green painted sign plank on the middle bay's back wall. Static scenery.
checks: FRONT tile: three open bays side by side, each with a heap you can see from the front
3/4 tile: the back and divider walls are slats with gaps between them, on square posts
3/4 tile: the heaps go dark brown, mid brown, green from one end to the other
BACK tile: a solid run of slats; the green sign plank sticks up over the middle bay
TOP tile: four divider walls and a back wall make three equal bays, open along the front
